answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Signed mountaineering instructor award with mountaineering council attestation stops them at the door: an award the council renews after assessed climbs, which means the vertex of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the nadir is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the island for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
